```yaml
name: Gemini Code Review

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Ruby
        uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
        with:
          ruby-version: '3.1'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          gem install gemini-ai-client

      - name: Run Gemini Code Review
        env:
          GEMINI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.GEMINI_API_KEY }}
        run: |
          gemini-ai-client --model gemini-2.5-flash --input-file .github/workflows/review.rb --output-file review.txt

      - name: Upload review as artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v3
        with:
          name: code-review
          path: review.txt
```
